The underlying proof point (naive produces a demonstrably wrong, smaller count; the tool's separator-aware pattern produces the correct, larger count) holds unchanged.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — corrected 'misses four of the five' to the verified 3-of-5 miss count; underlying naive-vs-correct distinguishing behavior unchanged.)*
